# Mahadev Mechanical Car Garage

> Complete Car Care Under One Roof in Gohana, Haryana. Modern multi-brand car workshop specializing in dealer-standard mechanical service, Japanese-tech engine decarbonization, automated AC servicing, car detailing, and OBD-II computerized diagnostics.

## Business Overview
- **Name**: Mahadev Mechanical Car Garage
- **Location**: Near JK Garden, Gohana–Panipat Road, Gohana, Haryana 131301, India
- **GPS Coordinates**: 29.1471882, 76.716434
- **Phone**: +91 82956 69463
- **WhatsApp**: +91 82956 69463
- **Website**: https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/

  - Sunday: 10:00 AM – 04:00 PM (By Appointment Only)

## Key Workshop Services & Dedicated Pages
- [Car Service in Gohana](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/car-service-gohana): Full periodic service packages starting at ₹3,499. Includes certified synthetic engine oil, OEM oil/air filters, fluid top-ups, spark plug check, and comprehensive 40-point safety inspection.
- [Car Washing in Gohana](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/car-washing-gohana): Professional snow foam and steam washing starting at ₹150. High-pressure underchassis mud removal, two-bucket hand wash, and scratch-free microfiber drying.
- [Car AC Service in Gohana](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/car-ac-service-gohana): Automated AC servicing starting at ₹999. Computerized refrigerant recovery, deep vacuum leak testing, compressor oil top-up, and precise R134a gas recharge.
- [Car Detailing in Gohana](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/car-detailing-gohana): Multi-stage machine compounding, swirl and light scratch removal, optical clarity polishing, interior steam extraction, and protective sealant.
- [Interior Car Cleaning in Gohana](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/car-interior-cleaning-gohana): High-power vacuum extraction, active foam seat shampoo, fabric stain removal, leather conditioning, and high-temp steam sanitization.
- [Engine Carbon Cleaning](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/services): In-chassis hydrogen decarbonization using Japanese-tech machinery. Cleans combustion chambers and intake valves without dismantling the engine.
- [OBD-II Computer Diagnostics](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/services): ECU error code scanning, live sensor diagnostics, check engine light analysis, and electrical troubleshooting.
